supplements.title: Mechanism of Asiatic acid against oesophageal squamous cell carcinoma: integration of network pharmacology and experimental validation.
supplements.summary: Asiatic acid fights esophageal cancer by targeting the PTGS2 protein and blocking a key growth pathway, reducing tumors in studies.

supplements.title: Network Pharmacology, Molecular Docking, Hematological Evaluation, and In Vivo Evidence Support Sakuranetin as a Redox and Inflammation-Modulating Agent Against Skin Tumorigenesis.
supplements.summary: Sakuranetin, a plant compound, protected mice from chemically-induced skin cancer by reducing harmful inflammation and oxidative stress.

supplements.title: Network pharmacology and molecular docking reveal the therapeutic mechanism of Hedyotis diffusa in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma: A bioinformatics analysis.
supplements.summary: Hedyotis diffusa herb compounds, particularly quercetin and beta-sitosterol, may treat esophageal squamous cell carcinoma by targeting cancer-related genes and MAPK signaling pathways.

supplements.title: Potential Role of PVP/Poloxamer 407 Nanofibers Loaded with Resveratrol Nanocrystals in Skin Cancer Therapy.
supplements.summary: Resveratrol nanofibers effectively reduced skin cancer tumor growth and symptoms in mice better than standard drug formulations.

supplements.title: S100A14 in Tumor-Derived EVs Targets PIAS3 to Reprogram Astrocytes and Induce Immunosuppressive Microenvironment Promoting Brain Metastasis and Germacrone Reversal Effect.
supplements.summary: S100A14 in tumor-derived particles promotes brain metastasis in lung and breast cancer; germacrone blocks this process effectively.

supplements.title: Network pharmacology, molecular docking, and In Vitro evaluation of morin against gastric cancer.
supplements.summary: Morin, a natural plant compound, effectively kills gastric cancer cells by targeting and blocking key growth-promoting proteins.

supplements.title: Therapeutic effects of selenium-enriched rapeseed against triple-negative breast cancer: involvement of Resolvin D5 activation and IL-17 signaling inhibition.
supplements.summary: Selenium-enriched rapeseed suppresses triple-negative breast cancer growth by activating a molecule that blocks inflammatory IL-17 signaling.

supplements.title: Melatonin enhances the antitumor and immunomodulatory effects of Bacillus Calmette-Guérin immunotherapy in a murine bladder cancer model.
supplements.summary: Melatonin combined with BCG immunotherapy improves treatment effectiveness against bladder cancer in mice.

supplements.title: Promising Efficacy of Coenzyme Q10 Supplementation as Adjunctive Therapy in Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis: A Randomized-Controlled Pilot Study.
supplements.summary: Coenzyme Q10 supplementation shows promise as an additional treatment for juvenile idiopathic arthritis, based on pilot study results.

supplements.title: 20(S)-Ginsenoside Rg3 suppresses lung cancer-associated fibroblast activation associated with IL-17RD-FGF-MAP2K4-JNK signaling.
supplements.summary: A plant compound called Ginsenoside Rg3 stops lung cancer-supporting fibroblasts from activating, offering new treatment potential.

supplements.title: Isoalantolactone ameliorates ulcerative colitis via gut microbiota-mediated modulation of intestinal barrier, T cell homeostasis, and metabolite reprogramming.
supplements.summary: Isoalantolactone treats ulcerative colitis by restoring gut bacteria balance and strengthening intestinal barriers in mice.

supplements.title: An antiproliferative bioactive flavanol from Vachellia nilotica nilotica (L.) P.J.H. Hurter & Mabb. against Osteosarcoma cell line: An in-vitro and in-silico study.
supplements.summary: A plant compound from Vachellia nilotica effectively killed osteosarcoma cancer cells in laboratory tests and shows promise for drug development.

supplements.title: Medicarpin suppresses thyroid cancer progression by inhibiting the AKT/NF-κB pathway and enhancing CD8+ T cell-mediated antitumor immunity.
supplements.summary: Medicarpin, a plant compound, slows thyroid cancer growth by blocking a key survival pathway and boosting immune cell attacks on tumors.

supplements.title: Inadequate Dietary Fibre Intake in Cardiovascular Disease Populations and Its Adverse Impact on Metabolic Health and Longevity: A National Retrospective Cohort Study.
supplements.summary: Higher dietary fiber intake significantly reduces all-cause, cardiovascular, and cancer mortality risk in heart disease patients.

supplements.title: Z-Guggulsterone Induces Ferroptosis in Chemoresistant Breast Cancer via a CDKN2B-Mediated Suppression of GTP Cyclohydrolase 1.
supplements.summary: Z-Guggulsterone, a natural compound, overcomes chemotherapy resistance in breast cancer by triggering ferroptosis through a specific molecular pathway.

off_label.title: Protective effect of nebivolol on bleomycin-induced lung fibrosis via suppressing TLR4/IL-1β/MMP-2 and TGF-β/HSP47 signaling pathways in rats.
off_label.summary: Nebivolol, a heart medication, protected rat lungs from bleomycin-induced scarring by blocking harmful inflammatory and fibrosis pathways.

off_label.title: Interconnection between Polycystic Ovary Syndrome, Immune Disorders, and Reproductive Outcomes.
off_label.summary: PCOS involves chronic inflammation and immune dysfunction that damage ovarian function and reduce pregnancy success, suggesting immune-targeted treatments could help.

off_label.title: Liver cancer-derived exosomal PTK6 induces the secretion of pulmonary CHI3L1 to facilitate lung metastatic niche formation.
off_label.summary: Liver cancer cells send signals that trigger lung cells to produce a protein enabling lung metastasis; blocking this protein reduces cancer spread.

off_label.title: Targeting NDUFS4 Disrupts Oxidative Phosphorylation and Induces Ferroptosis in Olaparib-Resistant Prostate Cancer.
off_label.summary: Blocking NDUFS4 in drug-resistant prostate cancer restores sensitivity to PARP inhibitors by disrupting energy production and triggering cell death.

off_label.title: Dexamethasone for Chemotherapy-Induced Nausea and Vomiting Prevention in Pediatric Patients: International Consensus.
off_label.summary: Experts created guidelines on when dexamethasone safely prevents chemotherapy nausea in children, weighing its benefits against risks.

off_label.title: Multimodal Management of Ulcerated Infantile Hemangioma With Beta Blockers and Laser Therapy-A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
off_label.summary: Combined beta-blocker and laser therapy may heal ulcerated infantile hemangiomas faster than beta-blockers alone, but evidence remains inconclusive.

off_label.title: Antidiabetic drug effects on gastrointestinal health: convergent evidence from a longitudinal cohort and Mendelian randomization study.
off_label.summary: A diabetes drug shows potential protective effects on gastrointestinal health based on combined evidence from patient studies and genetic analysis.

off_label.title: Off-label intravitreal eculizumab for geographic atrophy: report of the first two cases.
off_label.summary: Researchers tested an eye injection drug to slow vision loss from age-related macular degeneration in two patients, showing early safety promise.

off_label.title: Recent advances in drug repurposing for dentin repair.
off_label.summary: Researchers explore repurposing tideglusib and metformin drugs to improve dentin repair following pulp exposure.

off_label.title: Emerging roles of ATP citrate lyase in kidney diseases: from pathogenic driver to therapeutic target.
off_label.summary: ACLY enzyme drives kidney disease progression through metabolic and gene regulation pathways, emerging as a promising therapeutic target across multiple kidney conditions.

off_label.title: Synergistic induction of ferroptosis by paclitaxel and sunitinib is mediated through SLC7A11 in lung cancer.
off_label.summary: Two drugs combined trigger iron-dependent lung cancer cell death by targeting a protein called SLC7A11.

off_label.title: Canagliflozin Alleviates Hyperandrogen-Induced Granulosa Cell Ferroptosis in Polycystic Ovary Syndrome Mice by Activating the AMPK/GSK3β/NRF2 Pathway.
off_label.summary: Canagliflozin treats PCOS symptoms in mice by reducing oxidative stress and preventing cell death through a specific cellular pathway.

off_label.title: DJ-1 inhibition reshapes tumor microenvironment and potentiates immune checkpoint inhibitors.
off_label.summary: Blocking DJ-1 protein reprograms immune cells to enhance cancer immunotherapy effectiveness in resistant patients.

off_label.title: Pharmacological activation of WASp potentiates macrophage phagocytosis and enhances ibrutinib efficacy against mouse models of brain tumors.
off_label.summary: Activating WASp protein in immune cells restores their ability to kill brain tumor cells, improving the effectiveness of ibrutinib treatment.

off_label.title: Molecular and Cell Biological Characterization of Patient-Derived Head and Neck Squamous Carcinoma Cell Lines.
off_label.summary: Patient-derived head and neck cancer cells reveal specific genetic changes that could guide personalized treatment approaches.

biomarkers.title: Alistipes and Eggerthella shape the response to oncolytic adenovirus therapy in mice and humans through short-chain fatty acid metabolism.
biomarkers.summary: Specific gut bacteria—Alistipes and Eggerthella—influence how well oncolytic adenovirus cancer therapy works in patients.

biomarkers.title: Restoring dendritic cell migration: a gut reaction to boost vaccine efficacy in aging.
biomarkers.summary: Oral yeast nanoparticles restore immune cell migration in aging mice, improving vaccine effectiveness and immune response.

biomarkers.title: Targeted detection of amino acid profiles in pleural fluid and serum by liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry for estimating the risks of four aetiologies of pleural effusion: a proof-of-concept study.
biomarkers.summary: A blood and fluid test measuring amino acids can help doctors distinguish between four major causes of pleural effusion, including cancer.

biomarkers.title: Second primary cancers following hematologic malignancies: Epidemiology, pathobiology and clinical management.
biomarkers.summary: Cancer survivors treated for blood cancers face increased risk of developing second cancers due to treatment effects and genetic factors.

biomarkers.title: CDK9 interacts with a RanGTP-importin-β complex to regulate erythroid enucleation.
biomarkers.summary: CDK9 protein interacts with importin-β to regulate the final stage of red blood cell development, where the nucleus is expelled from maturing cells.

biomarkers.title: Advanced Triple-Negative Breast Cancer: Emerging Therapies and a Changing Treatment Landscape.
biomarkers.summary: New drug therapies like antibody-drug conjugates are improving treatment options for triple-negative breast cancer, a difficult-to-treat cancer subtype.

biomarkers.title: Resistance to neoadjuvant talazoparib in triple-negative breast cancer by BRN2-induced ATR/STAT3 pathways or SHLD2 subclone expansion.
biomarkers.summary: Triple-negative breast cancer develops resistance to PARP inhibitor talazoparib through BRN2-driven pathway activation or SHLD2-deficient subclone expansion.

biomarkers.title: [Ocular manifestations of Apert syndrome: a case report].
biomarkers.summary: Early recognition of eye problems in Apert syndrome—including bulging eyes and drooping lids—prevents permanent vision loss.

biomarkers.title: The safety and efficacy of in situ vaccine FOLactis for advanced hepatic malignancies.
biomarkers.summary: FOLactis, an in situ vaccine injected directly into tumors, combined with immunotherapy shows promise for treating advanced liver cancer.

biomarkers.title: Seizure-presenting IDH-wildtype glioblastoma and the upregulation of a synaptic signature.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified distinct genetic signatures in seizure-causing glioblastomas, revealing potential biological mechanisms underlying epileptic activity in brain tumors.

biomarkers.title: Reevaluating routine imaging: clinical utility of postoperative CT after stereotactic brain biopsy.
biomarkers.summary: Routine CT scans after brain biopsies may be unnecessary; symptom-based imaging could safely reduce unnecessary imaging.

biomarkers.title: Mechanism of Asiatic acid against oesophageal squamous cell carcinoma: integration of network pharmacology and experimental validation.
biomarkers.summary: Asiatic acid fights esophageal cancer by targeting the PTGS2 protein and blocking a key growth pathway, reducing tumors in studies.

biomarkers.title: Hypopigmented CD8+ Mycosis Fungoides in Sri Lanka: Clinicopathologic Evidence for an Indolent Variant.
biomarkers.summary: A milder form of skin lymphoma with reduced pigmentation and different immune markers was identified as common in Sri Lanka.

biomarkers.title: DDR1 Promotes Immune Evasion in Colorectal Cancer by Orchestrating IL-33-Mediated M2-like Polarization of Tumor-Associated Macrophages.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking DDR1 protein in colorectal cancer reduces immune-suppressing macrophages and improves immunotherapy effectiveness.

biomarkers.title: Adaptive Evolution of FOXO Family Regulating Lifespan Extension and Cancer Resistance in Long-Lived Species.
biomarkers.summary: Long-lived mammals evolved genetic changes in FOXO proteins that enhance cancer-fighting abilities, particularly through improved tumor suppression mechanisms.

trials.title: Alistipes and Eggerthella shape the response to oncolytic adenovirus therapy in mice and humans through short-chain fatty acid metabolism.
trials.summary: Specific gut bacteria—Alistipes and Eggerthella—influence how well oncolytic adenovirus cancer therapy works in patients.

trials.summary: Triple-negative breast cancer develops resistance to PARP inhibitor talazoparib through BRN2-driven pathway activation or SHLD2-deficient subclone expansion.

trials.summary: FOLactis, an in situ vaccine injected directly into tumors, combined with immunotherapy shows promise for treating advanced liver cancer.

trials.summary: Adding the drug tislelizumab to standard chemotherapy and radiation improved outcomes for advanced esophageal cancer patients in a clinical trial.

trials.title: DDR1 Promotes Immune Evasion in Colorectal Cancer by Orchestrating IL-33-Mediated M2-like Polarization of Tumor-Associated Macrophages.
trials.summary: Blocking DDR1 protein in colorectal cancer reduces immune-suppressing macrophages and improves immunotherapy effectiveness.

trials.title: Q&A: Renier Brentjens on Obstacles and Opportunities in CAR T-cell Therapy.
trials.summary: CAR T-cell therapy pioneer discusses current limitations and future improvements needed to expand this cancer treatment approach.

trials.title: Oncogenic Osteomalacia Due to Tumor in the Femoral Head Managed by Excision and Femoral Head Preservation: A Case Report.
trials.summary: A rare bone tumor causing mineral loss was successfully removed while preserving the femoral head, rapidly restoring normal phosphorus levels.

trials.title: Association of serum irisin levels with postoperative cognitive dysfunction in older patients following total hip or knee arthroplasty: A prospective observational study.
trials.summary: Low serum irisin levels may help predict cognitive decline after hip and knee surgery in older patients.

trials.title: Association of postoperative psychological interventions on compliance and survival in breast cancer patients: A single-center retrospective study.
trials.summary: Early structured psychological support after breast cancer surgery significantly improved patient adherence to hormone therapy and showed survival benefits.

trials.title: The diagnostic and therapeutic challenges of pulmonary epithelioid trophoblastic tumor: A case report and literature review.
trials.summary: Primary lung epithelioid trophoblastic tumor is extremely rare, making standardized treatment guidelines difficult to establish.

trials.title: Perioperative Outcomes from a Phase II Study of Robotic Cytoreduction and Hyperthermic Intraperitoneal Chemotherapy (HIPEC) for Patients with Gastric Cancer and Limited Peritoneal Metastasis: ROBO-CHIP Trial.
trials.summary: Robotic surgery combined with heated chemotherapy reduced recovery time for gastric cancer patients with limited peritoneal spread compared to traditional open surgery.

trials.title: Contrast-enhanced ultrasound LI-RADS nonradiation treatment response assessment: applications, challenges, and future directions.
trials.summary: Ultrasound without radiation offers a new way to assess liver cancer treatment response when standard imaging cannot be used.

mind_body.title: AI-enabled psychometric and psychophysiological assessment in psychiatric comorbidity of oncology patients: A systematic review.
mind_body.summary: AI tools can better detect depression and anxiety in cancer patients by continuously monitoring psychological distress beyond traditional screening methods.

mind_body.title: Association of postoperative psychological interventions on compliance and survival in breast cancer patients: A single-center retrospective study.
mind_body.summary: Early structured psychological support after breast cancer surgery significantly improved patient adherence to hormone therapy and showed survival benefits.

mind_body.title: Communication skill training in surgical residency: insights from Y-SICO (Young-Italian Society of Surgical Oncology).
mind_body.summary: Most surgical residents lack formal communication training despite recognizing its importance for delivering difficult diagnoses and managing patient care.

mind_body.title: Beyond tumor biology: nursing interventions for psychological and immune health in cancer patients.
mind_body.summary: Nursing interventions combining therapy, mindfulness, and lifestyle support improve psychological well-being and immune function in cancer patients.

mind_body.title: Breast cancer survivor and body: Exploring self-defining memories in an intervention pilot study.
mind_body.summary: A new psychological intervention helps breast cancer survivors process traumatic body-related memories and improve well-being.

mind_body.title: Five-Element Music and VR for Pain and Psychological Distress in Advanced Cancer: A Randomized Trial.
mind_body.summary: Music therapy and virtual reality together reduced pain and psychological distress in advanced cancer patients more effectively than standard care alone.

mind_body.title: Digital and AI-enhanced psychosocial interventions in breast cancer patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
mind_body.summary: Digital and AI-based mental health programs help reduce stress and anxiety in breast cancer patients, improving their overall well-being.

mind_body.title: How does self-compassion affect posttraumatic adaptation among lymphoma patients? A perspective based on network analysis.
mind_body.summary: Self-compassion components distinctly influence posttraumatic stress and growth differently in lymphoma patients through network analysis.

mind_body.title: A National Needs Assessment Identifies Training Gap in Integrative Oncology Education.
mind_body.summary: Most cancer doctors want integrative oncology training, but educational programs remain limited, creating a significant nationwide training gap.

mind_body.title: [Experience and access to acupuncture in patients undergoing anticancer treatment: A multicentric cross-sectional cohort study].
mind_body.summary: Cancer patients undergoing treatment rarely access acupuncture for managing side effects, despite reporting interest in this complementary therapy option.

mind_body.title: Association of marital and parental status with stress, support, adherence, and quality of life among breast cancer women.
mind_body.summary: Marital and parental status significantly influence stress levels, emotional support, treatment compliance, and quality of life in breast cancer patients.

mind_body.title: Early repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation for preventing chronic postoperative pain in older adults: a randomized clinical sub-study.
mind_body.summary: Early brain stimulation therapy reduced chronic pain after lung cancer surgery in older adults.

mind_body.title: Exploring the underlying structural mechanisms and whole-person perspectives on the desire for hastened death in patients with terminal cancer: A qualitative study.
mind_body.summary: Palliative care professionals identified structural factors driving terminal cancer patients' desire for hastened death.

mind_body.title: Development and validation of the questionnaire 'Spiritual Needs in Palliative Care' in Finnish.
mind_body.summary: Researchers created and tested a new Finnish questionnaire to help palliative care teams identify patients' spiritual and existential needs.

mind_body.title: A Qualitative Study of Strength, Hope, and Meaning: Multi-Stakeholder Perspectives on Spiritual Care for Breast Cancer.
mind_body.summary: Spiritual care helps breast cancer patients, families, and healthcare teams find strength, hope, and meaning throughout treatment.
